Brief Timeline

In 2013, Omar Gabr and Moataz Soliman, two college friends with a simple idea, started what would become something extraordinary. a decade later, it evolved into Instabug. And now, we’re entering a new chapter, Instabug is now Luciq, the mobile observability tool you need to deliver more reliable mobile experiences. Here is our story:

2012

We applied for Flat6Labs, an Egyptian incubator

2012

We won the 1st place in MIT with a prize of 50,000 $

2013

Attended MobileBeat event in SF

2013

Got our 1st round of Investment $300,000

2015

Became monetized and received our 1st payment

2016

We were accepted by YC

2016

Got our 2nd round of Investment $1.7M

2020

Got our 3rd round of Investment $5M

2022

Got out 4th round of investment $46M & the team was featured on Nasdaq

2025

The Launch of a New Era: Instabug is now Luciq!
